_notes: zoom.min and zoom.max: 1.0 means the whole photo fits the screen. 6.0 is six times closer.
zoom.wheel_factor: how much one scroll step zooms (1.15 = 15 percent).
targets[].center: [x, y] position on the photo, from 0.0 (left or top) to 1.0 (right or bottom).
targets[].radius: size of the clickable circle, as a fraction of the photo WIDTH.
targets[].min_zoom: how far the player must zoom in before the clue can be found.
